admission: user-authorized bounded local E(F_p) run; prior S3 HTTP 403 and missing .resume gates remain unqualified; no cloud spend

input.candidate_rule: xorshift scalar a mod 1013, test R=[a]G+Q
input.factor_base: first 8/16 canonical x-ordered points on E(F_1009)

arms.yield64: start B8, at trial64 expand to B16 iff hits<2; otherwise stay B8

run_order: targets ascending; for each target fixed8, fixed16, yield64; one fresh binary process per arm, append three outputs to that target's shard; preserve nonzero exit and stderr; no retry of an executed arm
expected: No outcome prediction. Print 24 arm records in eight sub-64KiB target shards; record all failures/censoring. Verify each accepted point-sum identity, modular rank/target pin and scalar result. Report base y tests/x scans, target/pair/candidate/group-verify additions, lookups, rank field operations, wall ns and process CPU ns per arm.

timing.wall: Rust Instant from process main before target/base construction through solution validation, excludes final print
timing.cpu: Darwin clock_gettime(CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID=12) over same interval; SDK MacOSX27.2 /usr/include/_time.h

prior_work.literature_note: Same fixed factor-base-size engineering question as prior run; no novelty or asymptotic claim. The eight target scalars and point-seeded streams are disjoint from V2; feedback threshold is frozen unchanged.

limits: Single public curve, tiny pair-sum relation oracle and one run per arm. Group-add field arithmetic, HashMap probes, allocation and validation group work are not collapsed into a single exact scalar cost; wall/CPU include execution of those components. Censoring is part of outcome.
